newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jules Roy air cargo revenue climbs strongly.
newsitem.headline: Jules Roy air cargo revenue climbs strongly.

text.p: French freight forwarder, Jules Roy, which is part of the Schenker Rhenus group, said it tabled a 1996 turnover from its air cargo activities totalling 715.4 million francs, up 42 percent on 1995.
The company said strong growth in airfreight turnover was due to an increase in traffic.
However, it declined to comment on the performance of individual routes nor on the volume of traffic handled last year.
Jules Roy said recent developments in the division included the placement of one of its staff at Air Littoral as part of a project on air cargo co-operation with the French airline.

The company would be opening an air cargo sales office in Montpellier during the course of 1997, taking its French network to 18, a company official confirmed. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
